newsitem.title: USA: Punk Ziegel & Knoell says Gretchen Knoell to quit.
newsitem.headline: Punk Ziegel & Knoell says Gretchen Knoell to quit.

text.p: Punk, Ziegel & Knoell said its managing director of corporate finance, Gretchen Knoell, will leave the bank to join Bear Stearns Cos Inc.

The company said the investment banking operation will now be led by Rick Beatty in San Francisco in the areas of technology and communications; Christopher daCunha in San Francisco in the area of health care information systems; and Julia Gregory in New York in the life sciences area.
The company also said it would change its name to Punk, Ziegel & Co as a result of Knoell's departure.
